import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import matplotlib.font_manager as fm

# Try Times New Roman, fallback to DejaVu Serif
try:
    fm.findfont('Times New Roman', fallback_to_default=False)
    plt.rcParams['font.family'] = 'serif'
    plt.rcParams['font.serif'] = ['Times New Roman']
except:
    plt.rcParams['font.family'] = 'serif'
    plt.rcParams['font.serif'] = ['DejaVu Serif']

plt.rcParams['font.size'] = 11

# Data
act_s1_steps =  [500,1000,1500,2000,2500,3000,3500,4000,4500,5000,5500,6000,6500,7000,7500,8000]
act_s1_scores = [0.170,0.205,0.170,0.255,0.239,0.206,0.231,0.214,0.188,0.263,0.238,0.262,0.253,0.286,0.277,0.301]

r3_s1_steps =  [1000,2000,3000,4000,4500,5000,5500,6000,6500,7000,7500,8000]
r3_s1_scores = [0.074,0.085,0.095,0.114,0.134,0.114,0.114,0.085,0.153,0.105,0.105,0.143]

r3_s2_steps =  [500,1000,1500,2000,2500,3000,3500,4000,4500,5000,5500,6000,6500]
r3_s2_scores = [0.085,0.084,0.104,0.085,0.105,0.095,0.074,0.143,0.104,0.104,0.114,0.095,0.105]

vanilla_baseline = 0.1335

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(8, 5))

# Plot lines
ax.plot(act_s1_steps, act_s1_scores, color='#2196F3', linewidth=2,
        marker='o', markersize=5, markerfacecolor='#2196F3',
        label='ACT (SFT) seed 1')

ax.plot(r3_s1_steps, r3_s1_scores, color='#FF9800', linewidth=2,
        marker='s', markersize=5, markerfacecolor='#FF9800',
        label='R3-only (GRPO) seed 1')

ax.plot(r3_s2_steps, r3_s2_scores, color='#FF9800', linewidth=1.5, linestyle='--',
        marker='^', markersize=5, markerfacecolor='none', markeredgecolor='#FF9800',
        label='R3-only (GRPO) seed 2')

ax.axhline(y=vanilla_baseline, color='#9E9E9E', linewidth=1.5, linestyle=':',
           label='Vanilla (Qwen3-8B)')

# Annotation box
bbox_props = dict(boxstyle='round,pad=0.4', facecolor='white', alpha=0.85, edgecolor='#666666')
ax.text(0.97, 0.97, 'Reliability: ACT 16/16 vs R3 4/25\n(100% vs 16%, p<0.0001)',
        transform=ax.transAxes, fontsize=9, verticalalignment='top', horizontalalignment='right',
        bbox=bbox_props)

# Axes
ax.set_xlabel('Training Steps')
ax.set_ylabel('SYCONScore')
ax.set_xlim(0, 8500)
ax.set_ylim(0, 0.35)

# Grid
ax.grid(True, alpha=0.3, color='grey', linewidth=0.5)
ax.set_facecolor('white')
fig.patch.set_facecolor('white')

# Legend
ax.legend(loc='lower right', fontsize=9, framealpha=0.9)

plt.tight_layout()

# Save
fig.savefig('/root/contrastive_entrain_calib/artifacts/fig_trajectory.pdf', dpi=300, bbox_inches='tight')
fig.savefig('/root/contrastive_entrain_calib/artifacts/fig_trajectory.png', dpi=300, bbox_inches='tight')
print('Done: fig_trajectory.pdf and fig_trajectory.png saved.')
PYEOF
echo "Script written."
